rav-chiyya-bar-ami.name: Rav Ḥiyya bar Ami
rav-chiyya-bar-ami.bio: Amora who transmits rulings in the names of earlier sages.
rav-chiyya-bar-ami.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a greying dark beard and a plain brown mantle, one hand raised as he repeats a ruling he received; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

chulfana.name: Ḥulfana
chulfana.bio: Sage in whose name Rav Ḥiyya bar Ami transmits a ruling about the priestly watches (Arakhin 28b).
chulfana.prompt: An elderly sage in his 60s with a long white beard and a simple undyed wool mantle, a quiet and reserved expression; background of a softly lit study hall with oil lamps.

chizkiyya-bar-biluto.name: Ḥizkiyya bar Biluto
chizkiyya-bar-biluto.bio: Amora who brought a difficulty before Rabbi Abbahu (Arakhin 28b).
chizkiyya-bar-biluto.prompt: A younger scholar in his 30s with a short dark beard and a light linen mantle, leaning forward as he raises a question; background of limestone arches and olive trees.
